newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end flat, focus on Sentul.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end flat, focus on Sentul.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended flat on Monday as worries over the volatile rupiah appeared to ease after the currency generally strengthened against the dollar, while the market focus was seen on newly-listed Bukit Sentul, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index was up 0.76 points, or 0.11 percent, at the close at 710.82 points. Decliners led advancers by 57 to 56 with 79 issues unchanged.

"Worries over the volatile rupiah appeared to ease as the currency has staged a mild rebound against the dollar after falling sharply last week, but players were still reluctant to make new decisions," one broker said.
Total turn-over was estimated at 656 billion rupiah.
Rupiah was traded at 2,583.00/88.00 against the dollar at 0945 GMT compared with 2,605.00/15.00 at the opening.
Brokers said the market focus was on property firm Sentul as it closed at 625 rupiah, or 25 percent above its initial offer price of 500 rupiah.
Sentul was the most active, with some 177 million shares traded.
Meanwhile, Bank Niaga rose 1,050 rupiah to 7,750 rupiah after touching a year high of 8,000 rupiah, with some 793,000 shares traded.
Brokers said the sharp rise was due to news reports that a privately-owned firm, PT Tunasmas Paduarta, planned to acquire a 50-percent stake in the bank, brokers said.
Tunasmas proposes to buy about a 40 percent stake in the bank from two major shareholders and a 10 percent stake from the public at a price of 8,000 rupiah per share.
Small-capitalised Langgeng Makmur Plastics Industry closed 50 rupiah lower at 925 rupiah after it resumed trading on Monday.
Langgeng was suspended on Friday after a sudden drop in its share price.
Bank Papan Sejahtera, which also resumed trading on Monday after it was suspended on Friday due to a sharp rise, fell 50 rupiah to 1,950 rupiah in thin trading.
